description: 推奨データセット(ベータ版) 12_公共施設一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 生駒市. 内閣官房情報通信技術総合戦略室が公開している「推奨データセット（ベータ版）」のフォーマット標準例に準拠した、公共施設一覧のデータです。. Coverage: 生駒市. The portal files it under the publisher 生駒市. Its tags are くらし, 推奨データセット, 施設. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
